privacy.title: Privacy
body: What we store: email address for sign-in, your display name (real name or pseudonym), municipality and neighbourhood (never your address), your posts, arguments, requests and offers.
What we never store: how you voted. Participation and vote are kept apart; the vote is only linked to a token via a secret server key, not to your account.
Hosting: database and sign-in at Supabase (data centre in Frankfurt am Main), web server at Vercel. [Add data processing agreements.]

Other services: e-mails are sent by Resend. If bot protection is on, Cloudflare Turnstile checks during sign-up and sign-in that a human fills in the form. The map view loads map material from OpenFreeMap, but only after you click “Load map”; that service sees your IP address. Listings only appear on the map at the centre of their place. When you share a link, our server fetches the page to show a preview. Google Photos is only used if you connect it yourself. [Check data processing agreements and transfers to third countries.]

Matching listings: so that offers and requests find each other, we compare the title, description, keywords, category and place of public listings. This happens in our database; private details are never compared.
Cookies: only technically necessary cookies for sign-in, language and appearance. No ads, no tracking.
Your rights: access, rectification, erasure (under “For me → Settings → Delete account”), restriction, portability, objection and complaint to a supervisory authority.
